label: H.R. 6472
title: Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act
short_title: Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.

summary: Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act This bill requires public institutions of higher education that participate in federal student aid programs to charge no more than in-state tuition and fee rates to students who are residents of Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, or the U.S. Virgin Islands, provided they are also U.S. nationals.
summary_short: Territorial Student Access to Higher Education Act This bill requires public institutions of higher education that participate in federal student aid programs to charge no more than in-state tuition and fee rates to students who are residents of Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, American Samoa, or the U.S.
